name: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar’s Yatra Scheme to visit the places connected with Dr. B.R. Ambedkar’s life in India
benefit:
- Organizing a tour for a group of about 50 participants every year to four memorial places: Janam Bhoomi (Mhow, Madhya Pradesh), Deeksha Bhoomi (Nagpur, Maharashtra), Mahaparinivaran Bhoomi (Delhi), and Chaitya Bhoomi (Mumbai).
- The total amount of expenses are fully borne by the Adi Dravidar Welfare and Scheduled Tribes Welfare Department.

_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be of the Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe community recognized by the Union territory of Puducherry. - The applicant must belong to this Union Territory by virtue of birth or continuous residence of not less than 5 years. - The applicant must not be less than 18 years old on the date of application. - The applicant must not be more than 50 years old on the date of application. - The applicant must be free from any contagious/communicable diseases. - Only one person per family can participate in a year. - The applicant must not have previously participated in the tour programme in his/her lifetime. - The applicant must not be a person who is availing assistance under prolonged disease. - The total annual income of the family of the applicant should not exceed ₹2,00,000/-. ##### ***Priority*** - Applicants shall be selected by seniority in age on a first come first served basis. - The number of participants for each region shall be decided by the UT of Puducherry from time to time based on the ratio of the applications received: _Puducherry - 32; Karaikal - 12; Yanam - 4; Mahe - 2 (If no application is received, may be considered for Puducherry region)._
